access_boundary: This record represents the o3-pro release identified by the dated snapshot o3-pro-2025-06-10, announced June 2025. OpenAI announced its deprecation and documents the shutdown date of December 11, 2026 with the GPT-5.6 Sol line at reasoning.mode pro as the recommended replacement. The o3 and o3-mini lines it derives from, the later GPT-5 family, the OpenAI platform, and ChatGPT remain separate product or service boundaries.
strengths: OpenAI documents the pinned snapshot, deprecation date, and recommended replacement first-party
The separate pricing and the Responses-API-only serving path are documented
tradeoffs: No developer-published weights are available for self-operation
Served only through the Responses API with no Chat Completions path
